_comment: Central per-repo metadata. Used by test-healing-agent and test-authoring-agent.
_usage: shared/repo_config.py load_repo_config(repo_name) — falls back to GITHUB_REPO_AUTOMATION env var

pr_checklist: Locator uses id/name/data-cy — not positional XPath or generated class names
Uses framework wrappers (Element.click, WaitHelper.*) — no raw Selenium
AssertHelper used for all assertions — no raw TestNG Assert
Page object constructor follows mandatory pattern (super → PageFactory → waitForLoaderDisappeared → waitForPageLoad)
Navigation methods return the next page object
logStep in test classes only, logComment in page objects/helpers
